design.name: fome-mc
design.license: The owner holds the rights to fome-mc and agent-ee and decided on 2026-10-18 that captured fome-mc reference sheets are committed as agent-ee fixtures (docs/decisions.md, fixtures/fome-mc/LICENSE-NOTICE.md). The sheets derive from FOME-Tech Polygonus b3176cb and Polygonus-Universal-112 ddcf0f7 (no top-level licence file in the local checkouts) and mck1117 wideband Rev C ca2adce (wideband is MIT upstream; docs/file-origins.json).

unassigned.reason: Root sheet: AMPSEAL connectors J1/J2, C1 bulk and R219 gear pull-up (FOMEMC-14); docs/BLOCK_LIBRARY.md lists them on the root, outside every block.
